items.statement: Cash flows from operations improved 321.86% to Rs. 67.54 crores in H1 FY25.
items.quote: Cash flows from operation significantly improved by 321.86% reaching Rs. 67.54 crores.

items.statement: Management received 40-45% of overdue payments from Middle East and Southeast Asia channel partners, expects 75-80% collection within two months, and targets 100% recovery.
items.quote: We have already received 40% to 45% of the payments from those partners and balance is also coming in due course. In another month or two, I think almost 75%-80% should be cleared.

items.statement: CFO assures investors that debtor collection is on track with micromanagement, targeting 70-80% by December and 100% eventually.
items.quote: We are doing a very micromanagement thing on that. And we want to assure all the investors that we will be able to collect the data as sir rightly said, by December we will be able to cover 70%-80% and our target is to collect the entire 100%.

items.statement: KP Group orders constituted 30-40% of H1 FY25 order book with the rest from outside customers including government and private players
items.quote: At present, in this half year, it was around 40% of KP Group and rest was from outsiders.

items.statement: KP Group order pipeline of approximately INR1,000 crores is separate from the INR1,000-2,000 crores external pipeline
items.quote: The confirmed order book of KP Group we have not shown it over here. So that is approximately, see KPI is going to set up 1.3 gigawatt of IP P plant. So automatically all the requirements will come to KP Green Engineering.

items.statement: All infrastructure requirements of KP Group companies will be sourced from KP Green Engineering at arm's length pricing
items.quote: Actually, all my infrastructure requirements will be taken from the Group company KP Green Engineering. Because everything is at arms-length, what I am going to pay outside, I am going to pay them.

items.statement: Direct exports rose to 25% of revenue in the current year from Rs 11 crore last year
items.quote: Direct exports last year were 11.00 Crores. But this year has gone up signiﬁcantly. 25% actually current year

items.statement: Cash flow from operations negative in current quarter due to increase in unbilled revenues and reduction in trade payables by around INR105 crores; expected to turn positive in future quarters
items.quote: For the current quarter, our cash flow from operations has been negative. It is basically because of an increase in the unbilled revenues and a trade payable which has got reduced by around INR105 crores.

items.statement: Trade receivables rose from INR10.52 crore at FY24 end to INR30.82 crore in H1 FY25 due to large advisory deals closed in Q2 with structured payment terms.
items.quote: The trade receivables have increased from INR10.52 crores in financial year '24 to INR30.82 crores in H1 financial year '25. This increase is on account of large advisory services done in quarter 2.

items.statement: Cash and cash equivalents decreased by about INR2 crore in H1 FY25 versus an increase of INR1.19 crore in H1 FY24, driven by the receivables build-up.
items.quote: With a net decrease in cash and cash equivalent of about INR2 crores versus an increase of INR1.19 crores in H1 '24. This is also because of the increase in the receivables in quarter 2 in financial year '25.

items.statement: Management collected about INR15 crore of receivables in H1 FY25, covering the INR10.5 crore opening balance plus INR5 crore of current period billings.
items.quote: We collected about INR15 crores already. So, we collected the INR10 crores that was due as of March plus another INR5 crores of this year, leaving us effectively about INR30 crore s of receivables

items.statement: All receivables are current, being paid per schedule, with zero write-offs or concerns.
items.quote: Absolutely. So, we have no concern in terms of receivables. All receivables are standard. All receivables are current. All receivables are being paid as per their payment schedule. And therefore, we have zero write-offs or zero concerns with receivables.

items.statement: Receivables may remain elevated at FY25 end because H2 deal closures will generate fresh invoices with 30-120 day payment terms.
items.quote: What we'll finish in H2, might stay outstanding to some extent.
